description: Returns one person from your audience with their counts, your tags, notes and mute, and their outreach status (owner, stage, last contacted). It also has their public profile where the platform shows one, with bio, company, location, website and linked accounts. profile.email is always null here. GitHub authors are looked up the same day, and profile is null until then.
